# Goldens TestWasmCommandGoldens expects not to build or run on wasip2/wasm
# (decision 0447 stage 3, 2026-11-02): goldens TestSelfhostWasm runs on
# wasip1/wasm (those of wasm_unsupported.txt are not tried) that a
# wasi:cli/command component cannot run yet. A golden not listed that fails,
# and a listed golden that passes, fail the test. Reason after the name.
# Since 2026-11-03 every golden is tried, those of wasm_unsupported.txt too
